title: 11 Up
tagline: Pairs that make 11. Clear the table.
blurb: Three pyramids, like the bar-top. Peel two open cards that make 11 or a matching face. Covered cards stay put. Next Card fills a hole and costs. Clear the table for a bonus. Two rounds.

copy.playing: Tap two open cards that make 11, or two of the same face.
copy.full: Table full. Pair or take score.
copy.covered: That card is covered. Peel an open 11.
